description: Fictional playable football countries, league formats, continental qualification metadata, clubs and squad strength profiles. Club and player names are intentionally unlicensed.
rating_notes: Overall bands are inspired by public football game rating ranges and current squad strength reporting, but do not copy licensed roster names.
Player profiles store football identity, position and OVR archetypes only; generated names remain fictional.
Domestic cups and international cups are modeled as metadata only until tournament simulation is added.
